title: MySQL 8.4 — Production Overview
description: Layer 2 collector view of an Azure Database for MySQL Flexible Server. Every panel reads MysqlMetrics in ADX; nothing here depends on Azure platform metrics, so it works identically on Premium SSD v2 preview servers.

query.query: MysqlMetrics | summarize LastSeen = max(Timestamp) by RunId | order by LastSeen desc | project RunId
MysqlMetrics | where RunId == '$run_id' | summarize by Host

panels.title: Collector heartbeat
panels.description: Seconds since the collector last reported. A dead collector flatlines every other panel, and a flatline looks exactly like a healthy idle server — so this panel comes first.

targets.query:
MysqlMetrics
| where Timestamp > ago(30m)
| where Metric == 'collector_heartbeat' and RunId == '$run_id'
| summarize LastBeat = max(Timestamp) by Host
| extend SecondsSinceLastBeat = datetime_diff('second', now(), LastBeat)
| project Host, SecondsSinceLastBeat

MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Metric == 'Threads_connected' and RunId == '$run_id'
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Value) by Host
| project Host, Connected = Value

panels.title: InnoDB buffer pool hit ratio
panels.description: 1 - (reads from disk / logical read requests). Sustained dips below 99% on a gaming workload usually mean the working set no longer fits in the buffer pool.

targets.query:
MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id'
| where Metric in ('Innodb_buffer_pool_reads', 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests')
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Value) by Host, Metric
| summarize Reads = sumif(Value, Metric == 'Innodb_buffer_pool_reads'), Requests = sumif(Value, Metric == 'Innodb_buffer_pool_read_requests') by Host
| where Requests > 0
| project Host, HitRatio = 1.0 - (Reads / Requests)

MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Metric == 'Slow_queries' and RunId == '$run_id'
| summarize arg_max(Timestamp, Value) by Host
| project Host, SlowQueries = Value

panels.title: Throughput (queries/sec)
panels.description: Derived at query time from the cumulative Queries counter. Negative deltas from a server restart are dropped here, but remain visible in the raw table.

targets.query:
MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where Metric == 'Queries' and RunId == '$run_id'
| order by Host asc, Timestamp asc
| extend PrevValue = prev(Value), PrevTs = prev(Timestamp), PrevHost = prev(Host)
| where Host == PrevHost
| extend Seconds = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, PrevTs)
| where Seconds > 0 and Value >= PrevValue
| project Timestamp, Host, QPS = (Value - PrevValue) / Seconds
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Connections and threads
panels.description: Threads_running is the saturation signal; Threads_connected only counts open sessions. A pool that stays connected but stops running work shows up as a gap between the two.

targets.query:
MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id'
| where Metric in ('Threads_connected', 'Threads_running', 'Threads_cached', 'Max_used_connections')
| project Timestamp, Metric, Value
| order by Timestamp asc

MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id'
| where Metric in ('Innodb_rows_read', 'Innodb_rows_inserted', 'Innodb_rows_updated', 'Innodb_rows_deleted')
| order by Metric asc, Timestamp asc
| extend PrevValue = prev(Value), PrevTs = prev(Timestamp), PrevMetric = prev(Metric)
| where Metric == PrevMetric
| extend Seconds = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, PrevTs)
| where Seconds > 0 and Value >= PrevValue
| project Timestamp, Metric, Rate = (Value - PrevValue) / Seconds
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Connection errors (per sec)
panels.description: Aborted_connects counts failed handshakes — with require_secure_transport=ON, a client missing TLS config lands here rather than in the error log.

targets.query:
MysqlMetrics
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id'
| where Metric in ('Aborted_connects', 'Aborted_clients')
| order by Metric asc, Timestamp asc
| extend PrevValue = prev(Value), PrevTs = prev(Timestamp), PrevMetric = prev(Metric)
| where Metric == PrevMetric
| extend Seconds = datetime_diff('second', Timestamp, PrevTs)
| where Seconds > 0 and Value >= PrevValue
| project Timestamp, Metric, Rate = (Value - PrevValue) / Seconds
| order by Timestamp asc

panels.title: Error log (performance_schema.error_log)
panels.description: Azure Flexible Server publishes no error-log diagnostic category, so Layer 1 cannot supply this at all. These rows exist only because the collector reads the ring buffer directly.

targets.query:
MysqlEvents
| where $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
| where RunId == '$run_id'
| project Timestamp, Level, ErrorCode, Subsystem, Message
| order by Timestamp desc
| take 200
